reason: I want to follow whether cold material can persist by mixing the dispersed gas with the arriving cold stream.
expectation: The encounter may cool or gather some outer gas, though I am unsure whether the cold material survives.

alternatives.reason: The dusty cloud could also encounter the cold stream, but I chose to follow the dispersed gas first.

effect: The stream formed a sheltered cold pocket, completing the survival goal; I can now follow what happens to it.
reaction: The contrast between the cold pocket and the much larger hot surroundings is interesting.
reason: Adding surviving grains to the cold cloud may lead toward something the cluster can illuminate.
expectation: The grains may become part of a dusty cold cloud, though I am unsure whether that directly advances the remaining goal.

alternatives.reason: The older dusty cloud could also meet the cold stream, but I want to follow the newly formed pocket first.

effect: The surviving grains made a dusty cloud capable of scattering starlight, suggesting a direct way to address the remaining goal.
reaction: The connection between surviving dust and scattered light is clear.
reason: Combine the cloud with the surviving cluster to see what its stars illuminate.
expectation: The cluster's light will scatter off the dust, likely completing the remaining goal.

effect: The cluster illuminated the dusty cloud by scattering light, completing the remaining goal without forming new stars.
reaction: That was a clear, satisfying connection between the surviving grains and the cluster.

mostWorthwhile.text: Illuminating the dusty cloud brought the surviving cluster and material from the galaxy's history together without making another nursery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding grains was a straightforward intermediate step, though it established why the cloud could scatter light.

surprise.text: The cold stream made a sheltered pocket that stayed cold even though most of the surroundings remained hot and thin.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless; the offered compatible combinations and resulting descriptions made the sequence understandable.

continue.text: I would continue: the cold pocket and reflected light made me curious about how these surviving materials might develop.
